verdict.rationale: Weave ships an official MCP server and 'W&B skills' that let coding agents (e.g., Claude Code) read traces/evaluations and 'execute automatic iteration loops on their own' via natural-language-driven agent workflows, effectively letting AI-native users operate Weave through NL commands routed via MCP tools (docs-20, docs-43, docs-44, docs-45, probe-4). Missing for 10: no first-party built-in chat/NL console inside Weave itself, and no independent/hands-on report confirming the MCP-driven operation works reliably in practice.
